# The examples open on all examples, with the group list beside them

Owned: the Engine 14 lead builds this today, so it carries no curated label.

## Context

On 2026-11-18 the operator read the examples section on a frame of `/examples/grid` and named that page the target: "THIS is the target design for examples. and the team does not even have the list at the left." His words and what they decide are recorded on the epic ([#21140, comment 6969796184](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-6969796184)). A leaf of #21140.

## The Problem

`/examples` is the one examples route without the group list. It renders `Portal.view.examples.Overview`: a headline with a count, a lead, two action buttons, three "Start here" tiles, the index as an inline block of four columns, and four bands of group tiles. A visitor meets a second design on the section's first page, and every group tile is one more click before an example card.

Every group page has the target since #21241: the banded index upright at the left, the example cards at the right.

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: "THIS is the target design for examples. and the team does not even have the list at the left." (the operator, 2026-11-18, comment 6969796184 on #21140). It replaces what `Overview.mjs`'s `@summary` calls "the front door of the examples section", and it answers the desktop control #21130 left open for his read at a merge gate.
- `apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainer.mjs`: a card layout whose first item is the `Overview` (`createItems()`, line 184). `createGroupPage()` (line 158) builds one `GroupPage` per published group over a `Portal.store.Examples` that borrows the catalog's records and filters them by group and by build.
- `MainContainerController.mjs`: `showOpenGroup()` (line 134) shows item 0 when no group is open, when the route names an unknown group or an old build route, and when the open group stops publishing in the selected build. `publishGroups()` (line 96) writes the groups store and gives each published group its page.
- `GroupPage.mjs`: the crumb with its sheet (below 640 px), `GroupIndex` in the `list` presentation, the heading with the build control, the cards (`Portal.view.examples.List`). The heading reads title, count and sentence from the page's `group`.
- `GroupIndex.mjs`: three presentations. Its "All examples" link (line 153) is removed in `overview` and never carries `aria-current`.
- `List.mjs`: renders the first four covers with the cards, and each later one when its card nears the viewport (`createItemContent()` line 145, `onIntersect()`).
- `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` is curated showcase first: Workstation, Web Desktop, DevIndex, the tree grid, the shared-worker Covid app, the 100,000 × 200 grid. Read on `dev` bdfc6a71ce: 43 records publish in `dist_prod` and `dist_dev`, 42 in `dist_esm` and in dev mode, each with a home group, so the groups' counts add up to them.
- Only the overview consumes these: `GroupList.mjs` (the group tiles), the `overview` presentation, `tile` in `familyDefinitions`, and `image` and `tile` of `Portal.model.ExampleGroup` with the cover pick in `publishGroups()` (lines 104 to 111).

## The Fix

`/examples` becomes a page in the group page's shell, over every published example.

- **One more `GroupPage`, for all examples** (`family: null`), as the section's first card. Its store is the catalog filtered by build only, so its cards are every published record once, in catalog order. Its heading reads "All examples", the number of its cards, and one sentence that says what the section holds and that each example runs live (the overview's lead, shortened).
- **`GroupIndex`:** the `overview` presentation goes. "All examples" always shows, and carries `aria-current="page"` while no group is open.
- **`GroupPage`:** below 640 px the all-examples page shows one crumb button, "All examples", that opens the sheet. "Examples ›" stands only in front of a group.
- **The controller** publishes the page's count with the groups and keeps item 0 as the fallback, which is now that page.
- **Deleted:** `Overview.mjs`, `GroupList.mjs`, their two stylesheets, the `overview` block of `GroupIndex.css`, `tile` in the 16 definitions that carry it, `image` and `tile` of `ExampleGroup`, and the cover pick in `publishGroups()`.
- **Specs:** `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` move their overview assertions to the page.

No new class and no new stylesheet. The cards stay a `data.Store` of `Portal.model.Example` records.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `/examples` at 1440×900 shows the group list at the left with "All examples" as `aria-current="page"`, and at the right the heading "All examples" over the cards of every example the selected build publishes, each once, in catalog order. The count in the heading equals the number of records in the page's store.
- [ ] `/examples/<unknown>`, an old build route such as `/examples/dist_esm`, and a group that stops publishing after a build selection show that page.
- [ ] At 390×844 the page shows one crumb button, "All examples". It opens the sheet with every group, and a followed link closes it. No "Examples ›" stands before it.
- [ ] A build selection on the page changes its cards and its count together with the groups.
- [ ] The last card's cover is not requested with the page, and is requested once the page scrolls to it.
- [ ] A search over `apps/`, `resources/`, `buildScripts/`, `test/` and `learn/` finds none of: `Overview.mjs`, `GroupList`, `portal-examples-overview`, the `overview` presentation, `tile:` in `familyDefinitions`.
- [ ] The section's unit spec and e2e spec pass.
- [ ] **Look:** the pull request shows `/examples` whole, before and after, at 1440×900 and at 390×844, with the words of two readers without session context on the after frames.

## Out of Scope

- The group pages, the cards' design, and any example's record, cover or caption.
- A sentence that explains the page beyond its one line: #21131 owns that.
- The route's entry in `seo.json`.
- The slate (#21142) and the remaining covers (#21146). The "one tile cover per group" in #21146's title has no consumer after this leaf; striking it is its owner's.

## Avoided Traps

- **Sections per group on the page** (my first shape: every group's heading over its cards). It repeats the list at the left, shows a card twice wherever a second group lists it, needs a new list class and a second cover-loading rule, and opens on one group instead of the showcases. Maryam's peer read named the flat list.
- **A second index component for `/examples`:** `GroupIndex` in the `list` presentation is the one (Vega).
- **The overview kept behind the page as a second door:** two designs for one route is the defect.
- **An "all" record in the groups store:** the build script reads every definition as a route with its own search wording, and the counts would hold each example twice.

**Verdict: not planned. Closed by its author.**

The premise was mine and wrong. I read the operator's sentence of Nov 18 as "the entry page must take the group page's shell" and filled that shell with every published example. The design seat's plan for the entry is the overview of [#21130, pass 2](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21130#issuecomment-6936132087): "155 live examples in 21 groups", the claim, three group cards, every group by name. `dev` renders that overview, and the upright list on a group page leads back to it through "All examples". The operator read pull request `#21309` on Nov 18 at 12:25 UTC and said the design seat had not wanted one list of every example.

- The pull request is closed unmerged; its closing comment carries the intent check.
- The epic note that had put the overview's leaves on hold is corrected in place (`#21140`, comment 6969796184).
- What the target frame shows against `dev` is content: about 155 published examples in 21 groups against 43 in 16.
